description: For EXISTING apps: emits the recommended top-up wallet integration — ledger schema + cumulative-credit webhook handler + atomic invoice-settle function. Credits crypto payments to a user's balance first, then debits invoices from it, so over/under/late/duplicate payments become balance states, not payment exceptions. Pair with the payram-topup-wallet-integration skill. (New store with no users? Use the checkout/plugin path instead.)

framework.description: Server framework for the webhook handler + settle function.

part.description: Which piece to emit: 'schema' (ledger DDL), 'webhook' (cumulative-credit handler), 'settle' (atomic invoice debit), or 'all'.
